title: Mitsuba and Spanish Chicken Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful stir fry made with mitsuba, spanish chorizo, and chicken, all in a savory sauce. This Chinese-inspired recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced chorizo and cook until browned, about 2-3 minutes.
Remove the chorizo from the wok and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the wok.
Add the chicken to the wok and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the wok and set aside with the chorizo.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the wok and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped mitsuba leaves to the wok and cook until wilted, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the cooked chorizo and chicken back to the wok.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, hoisin sauce, and sesame oil.
Pour the sauce over the chicken and chorizo mixture in the wok.
Stir everything together to combine and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
